## Summary
A concise overview of the change, design rationale, or bug fix.

## Motivation & Context
- Why is this change necessary?
- Which issue does this resolve?

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization / refactor
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / CI improvement

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`npm test`)
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passing (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Distribution bundle rebuilt (`npm run build`)
